places.name: Jiufen Old Street
places.ai_summary: A charming mountain town known for its narrow streets, tea houses, and stunning views of the coastline.
places.place_tip: Try the local taro balls and enjoy the sunset view.
places.address: Jiufen, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Shifen Old Street & Sky Lanterns
places.ai_summary: A historic street famous for releasing sky lanterns and its proximity to the Shifen Waterfall.

opening_hours.notes: Sky lanterns available until closing time.

places.place_tip: Purchase a sky lantern and write your wishes before releasing it.
places.address: Shifen, Pingxi District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Shifen Waterfall
places.ai_summary: A picturesque waterfall often referred to as Taiwan's Niagara Falls.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes as the trail can be slippery.
places.address: Shifen, Pingxi District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Pingxi Line Railway Villages
places.ai_summary: A series of quaint villages along the historic Pingxi railway line, perfect for exploring and photography.
places.place_tip: Take the train to explore multiple villages in one day.
places.address: Pingxi District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Yehliu Geopark (Queen’s Head)
places.ai_summary: A unique geological park featuring the iconic Queen's Head rock formation and other natural wonders.
places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and bring sunscreen.
places.address: Yehliu Village, Wanli District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Keelung Miaokou Night Market
places.ai_summary: A famous night market in Keelung known for its wide variety of street food and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is during dinner hours.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the seafood stalls and the local delicacies.
places.address: Keelung, Taiwan

places.name: Heping Island Park (Keelung)
places.ai_summary: A scenic park in Keelung offering beautiful coastal views, walking trails, and historical sites.
places.place_tip: Explore the coastal trails and visit the old fort.
places.address: Heping Island, Keelung, Taiwan

places.name: Tamsui Old Street & Fort San Domingo
places.ai_summary: A historic area in Tamsui with a well-preserved old street, Fort San Domingo, and beautiful river views.

opening_hours.notes: Fort San Domingo last entry at 17:00.

places.place_tip: Visit the fort for a glimpse of history and a great view of the sunset.
places.address: Tamsui, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Bali Left Bank Riverside Park
places.ai_summary: A riverside park in Bali, New Taipei City, ideal for cycling, walking, and enjoying riverside views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike to explore the park and enjoy the riverside breeze.
places.address: Bali, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Fuguijiao Lighthouse (Taiwan’s North Cape)
places.ai_summary: A historic lighthouse located at the northernmost point of Taiwan, offering panoramic ocean views.
places.place_tip: Check the weather forecast before visiting, as it can be foggy.
places.address: Fuguijiao, Shimen District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Jinguashi Gold Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the gold mining history of the Jinguashi area, with informative exhibits and scenic views.
places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a hike on the nearby trails.
places.address: Jinguashi, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

attribution.title: 黃金博物館-黃金館
attribution.author: Lenovo-lin

places.name: Houtong Cat Village
places.ai_summary: A unique village known for its large population of friendly cats and cat-themed attractions.
places.place_tip: Bring cat treats to interact with the cats.
places.address: Houtong, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Bitoujiao Cape Trail
places.ai_summary: A scenic coastal trail leading to the Bitoujiao Lighthouse, offering stunning ocean views.

opening_hours.notes: Best hiked in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes and bring water.
places.address: Bitoujiao, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Elephant Trunk Rock (Shenao)
places.ai_summary: A unique rock formation resembling an elephant's trunk, located along the coast.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera for photos.
places.address: Shenao, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Yeliu Ocean World & Harborfront
places.ai_summary: An ocean-themed park with an aquarium, marine shows, and a scenic harborfront area.
places.place_tip: Check the schedule for marine shows and plan your visit accordingly.
places.address: Yeliu, Wanli District, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Wulai Hot Springs & Waterfall
places.ai_summary: A popular hot spring area with public baths, private hot spring hotels, and a scenic waterfall.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited on weekdays to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Bring your own towel and toiletries if using public baths.
places.address: Wulai, New Taipei City, Taiwan

attribution.title: A bridge in Wulai (12239545553)

places.name: Shimen Cave & Laomei Green Reef (seasonal)
places.ai_summary: A scenic area with a sea cave, unique rock formations, and a green reef visible during low tide.
places.place_tip: Check the tide schedule before visiting.
places.address: Shimen, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Tamsui Fisherman’s Wharf & Lover’s Bridge
places.ai_summary: A popular waterfront area in Tamsui with a fishing wharf, seafood restaurants, and the iconic Lover’s Bridge.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon or evening.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a seafood dinner at the wharf and take a stroll on Lover’s Bridge.
places.address: Tamsui, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Ruifang Old Street Snack Walk
places.ai_summary: A delightful walk through Ruifang Old Street, famous for its traditional snacks and local delicacies.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Try the local herbal rice cake and peanut ice cream roll.
places.address: Ruifang, New Taipei City, Taiwan

places.name: Jinguashi Teapot Mountain Hike
places.ai_summary: A popular hiking trail in Jinguashi offering stunning views of the coastline and the famous Teapot Mountain.

opening_hours.notes: Best hiked in the early morning.

places.place_tip: Bring enough water and wear proper hiking shoes.
places.address: Jinguashi, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
